info.name: Terra360 API - Field Officer Portal
info.description:
Comprehensive Postman & Thunder Client collection for the Terra360 Field Officer Portal backend.
Covers Officer Profile, My Tasks, Assigned Area Map, Villager Reports, Real-Time Road Status, and Sector Emergency Alerts.

item.name: 01. Officer Profile & Context
item.description: Endpoints to inspect authenticated officer metadata and update language preferences.

request.description: Returns authenticated officer metadata (Name, Department, Assigned Area/Sector, Phone, Language, active duty status, badge number).

item.name: 02. My Inspection Tasks
item.description: Endpoints to manage inspection tasks assigned by the disaster officer.

request.description: Fetches inspection tasks assigned specifically to this officer by the disaster officer.
Transitions task status to 'In_Progress' and logs starting timestamp.
Marks task as 'Completed' and logs completion notes with UTC timestamp.

item.name: POST Escalate Task to Central Dashboard

request.description: Updates status to 'Escalated' and dispatches immediate notification to central disaster officer dashboard.

item.name: 03. Assigned Area Map
item.description: Spatial GeoJSON data for villages, road stretches, danger zones, hazard markers, and task routes.

request.description: Returns GeoJSON boundaries, danger zones with risk weights, active villager markers, and navigation route endpoints.

item.name: 04. Villager Reports
item.description: Endpoints to review, verify, reject, or escalate citizen landslide hazard reports.

request.description: Retrieves citizen reports logged within the officer's assigned geographic boundary.
Marks citizen report as 'Verified' with inspector notes and photo URL.
Marks report as 'Rejected' with required mandatory rejection reason.

item.name: POST Escalate Report to High Command

request.description: Escalates report straight to central disaster high command with urgency metadata.

item.name: 05. Real-Time Road Status
item.description: Endpoints to view and broadcast road conditions to central dashboard.

request.description: Returns latest real-time status of all road segments in the officer's area.

body.raw:
{
  "roadSegmentId": "ROAD-NH29-S4",
  "stretchName": "NH-29 KM 38 to KM 52 (Phesama – Dzüdza)",
  "condition": "Partially Blocked",
  "reason": "Single-lane traffic in effect. JCB excavator clearing outer lane debris at KM 42+300.",
  "photoUrl": "https://terra360.in/uploads/roads/nh29-km42-partial.jpg"
}

request.description: Pushes road condition (Open | Caution | Partially Blocked | Blocked) and syncs immediately with central dashboard.

item.name: 06. Sector Emergency Alerts
item.description: Endpoints to fetch active disaster alerts and acknowledge protocols.

request.description: Returns active emergency alerts and disaster protocols relevant strictly to the officer's assigned area.
Sets acknowledged: true with officer ID and UTC timestamp.
